answer.reason: Several events of Israel's story took place in the plains of Moab, so the place earns a short line.

clauses.english: was where Moses and Eleazar numbered the children of Israel
clauses.quote: who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab

clauses.english: was where Israel wept thirty days for Moses
clauses.quote: the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days

doubts: NUM 22:3 and DEU 34:5-6 speak of the people or the land of Moab rather than the plains, so I left them out.
Other events there (Israel camping, the LORD's commands, the distribution of lands east of Jordan) were left out to keep the line short.
